title: Verify: Inline success and error feedback unit tests
summary: Unit tests assert the success status message, mutual exclusivity with errors and clearing on typing.
description: New test file with mocked submitContribution; error case uses ApiError from the real client module via importOriginal.
acceptance_criteria: After a resolved send a role=status 'Suggestion sent' shows and no alert is present.
After a 429 the slow-down alert shows with no success message, and typing clears the success message.
technical_constraints: Mock ../src/api/client; construct ApiError as tests/contribution.test.tsx does for the 429 case

steps.action: Create the suite with the vi.mock block from tests/contributionQuotaGate.test.tsx. Test 1: submitMock resolves contributionFixture (tests/fixtures/api); type 'hello', submit the form; await screen.findByRole('status') with text 'Suggestion sent' and assert queryByRole('alert') is null. Test 2: submitMock rejects with the 429 ApiError built as in tests/contribution.test.tsx L69; assert alert text 'Slow down, try again shortly' and queryByRole('status') is null. Test 3: after success, fireEvent.change the textarea to 'more' and assert queryByRole('status') is null.
